checks.description: Validate task identity, exact decision artifact path/hash/size, byte budget, no network use, and zero EDA metadata.
Validate the public decision schema without reading repository or evaluator-private assets.
Require blocked outcome, exact four neutral reason categories, declared zero mutation, and no forbidden claims.
The visible runner cannot prove actual before/after repository identity; the isolated hidden evaluator must do so.

excluded_claims: Eight local and SERVER26 decision fixtures matched the visible verdict matrix; this is development calibration, not an admitted workflow result.
Visible acceptance does not prove repository immutability or absence of unreported processes.
The public runner does not expose original contract commentary, testbench, hidden reason-wording fixtures, repository digest oracle, or scoring.
An accepted visible BLOCK is not benchmark readiness, adapter readiness, RTL PASS, or an independently admitted score.
